title: Cloud-Native E-Commerce Microservices Platform
description: Production-oriented DevOps platform for a real-time e-commerce microservices application, demonstrating automated AWS infrastructure provisioning, container orchestration, Kubernetes networking, GitOps and end-to-end CI/CD.
features: Reusable AWS VPC and EKS infrastructure
Terraform remote state and state locking
Persistent storage using Kubernetes PV and PVC
End-to-end CI/CD from source commit to Kubernetes deployment
challenges: Building a repeatable DevOps delivery platform that could manage infrastructure and application deployments independently while maintaining consistency across AWS, Terraform, Docker and Kubernetes environments.
solution: Designed the infrastructure using Terraform, containerized the microservices with Docker, deployed the workloads to Amazon EKS, configured Kubernetes networking and AWS DNS, and implemented GitHub Actions and Argo CD to establish an automated CI/CD and GitOps delivery model.

title: AWS S3 to Google Cloud Storage Migration
description: Production-oriented cross-cloud migration of approximately 15 TB of object data from AWS S3 to Google Cloud Storage, focusing on data integrity, minimal downtime, secure access, incremental synchronization and controlled production cutover.
features: AWS S3 to Google Cloud Storage transfer
Managed bulk transfer using Storage Transfer Service
Incremental synchronization for changing production data
Object count and total byte reconciliation
Controlled production cutover with minimal downtime
Rollback capability using the original S3 source
challenges: Migrating approximately 15 TB of production data between cloud providers while maintaining data integrity, handling continuously changing objects, minimizing application downtime and preserving a reliable rollback path.
solution: Used Google Cloud Storage Transfer Service for bulk and incremental migration, implemented multi-level data reconciliation and integrity validation, secured cross-cloud access using least-privilege IAM, performed a controlled final synchronization and retained the AWS S3 source during the rollback window.

title: AWS Cloud Cost Optimization & Governance Framework
description: Production-oriented AWS cost optimization and governance framework demonstrating FinOps practices, infrastructure rightsizing, cost visibility, resource governance, controlled automation and continuous savings validation.
features: AWS cost analysis and spending visibility
NAT Gateway and data transfer cost analysis
challenges: Reducing AWS cloud expenditure without compromising production availability, performance, security or disaster recovery while establishing a repeatable and controlled optimization process.
solution: Implemented a structured FinOps workflow covering cost analysis, rightsizing, scheduling, storage and networking optimization, AWS Budgets, IAM governance and Terraform automation, with production changes following review, approval, monitoring and savings validation.

title: AWS Cloud-Native E-Commerce Platform
description: Production-oriented AWS cloud-native e-commerce architecture demonstrating containerized microservices, Infrastructure as Code, automated CI/CD, secure networking, managed AWS services, observability and reliability engineering.
features: Containerized services using ECS and AWS Fargate
API Gateway and ALB-based API routing
DynamoDB and RDS workload-specific data stores
Scalability, reliability and disaster recovery design
challenges: Designing a scalable and secure cloud-native e-commerce platform with independently deployable services while maintaining reliable communication, strong security, observability, operational simplicity and controlled infrastructure management.
solution: Designed an AWS architecture using ECS/Fargate for microservices, CloudFront and S3 for frontend delivery, API Gateway and ALB for application routing, DynamoDB and RDS for data persistence, SQS/SNS for asynchronous workflows, Cognito for authentication, Terraform for infrastructure automation and CloudWatch with GitHub Actions for observability and CI/CD.
